title: oenothera coloradensis
intro: Oenothera coloradensis, commonly known as the Colorado evening primrose, is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera coloradensis include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful for treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
